title: Example idea — click me to see the deep dive
description: Ideas start here before they're worth a card. Open one to brainstorm it properly.
context: The deep-dive page holds everything needed to decide whether an idea deserves development: what it's really about, the arguments each way, and the decision lens.
validation: How we would know it works — the checks you would run, the surface you would open. Required before this idea can be promoted.
compounding: If building this also makes three later features cheaper, say so here — infrastructure that compounds beats features that don't.
cons: Might distract from the current milestone
